headline: Sensex and Nifty Surge Over 500 Points as Easing Oil Prices and Global Rallies Boost Investor Sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Falling crude oil prices provided relief to the market
Market rebound after six consecutive weekly falls
Positive global cues and a rally in US AI shares
Easing concerns over West Asia tensions
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 564 points to close above the 23,400 mark
Core industries growth slowed to 4.8% in August due to iron ore and coal drag
NHAI issued new guidelines for access-controlled high-speed highways
India and Canada are scheduled to hold trade pact talks from October 5
summary: The Indian stock market ended a six-week losing streak with the Sensex jumping 564 points, driven by falling crude oil prices and positive global cues. While core industry growth slowed to 4.8% in August, investor sentiment was bolstered by a rally in US AI stocks. Key developments include new NHAI highway guidelines and upcoming India-Canada trade negotiations.
